Name: Horses in your Barn
Author: HopeWasHere
Description:
This mod is not a replacement for your pigs, rather an enhancer. Using Lavapulse's Custom Animal Breeds Toolkit: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/custom-animal-breeds-toolkit-v0-6-1-2-now-with-lite-mode.112153/ you can add different breeds to your game. For example, if you had four or five skins you liked for your cows and couldn't pick one, now you can add all of them to your game.

This mod takes the vanilla horse, adds a foal (from Harvest Moon for SNES) and makes it so they can walk about your farm like the rest of your animals. This is a template, so if you have many (many, many, many...) horse retextures you like, you can replace the files with which ever you like. And because of the Custom Animal Breeds Mod, you can add ALL of them to your game.

Feel free to edit and use the foal in whatever you would like.

You will need the [b]Tubular Toolkit[/b] and [b]Xnb_node[/b]

How to use Tubular Toolkit from someone who doesn't know what they're doing:

You have to put xnb_node in the same folder as the game. For example, I have the game on steam, so the file location is Local Disk (C[img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]:/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley. That folder should also hold your Content and Mods folders.
The only way I've gotten the toolkit to work is on the desktop. With the xnb_node in that folder, and the toolkit on the desktop it should load the full version. In the toolkit load your save file (found appdata/roaming/stardewvalley/saves) and that should show you all of the animals you own in your game. Next make sure to load farm animals to be sure you got all of the animals in your game. The next tab is where you add animals. It's fairly self explanatory, just put what you want it to be called first, then the breed, then add the files. If you're adding a sheep you have to add the sheared image too. If you have a baby image add that too if you want. The last tab is where you manage the animals that are in your game, in case you want to delete some. Once you've added animals, go back to the first tab and change the animals you own into the new breeds, then save the game.
Hopefully that makes sense, good luck [img]http://community.playstarbound.com/styles/default/xenforo/clear.png[/img]:)

For troubleshooting and other mods by me, check out the official discussion here: http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/garages-horses-and-hair-oh-my.130359/
